driverIncident.description: iterations 1-6 pre-registered N=6; the first driver pass completed iterations 1-5, then crashed during iteration 6 on revision rhema-pr-206-worker-43139c6-00007-hmp with an unhandled pg-boss client 'error' event (Connection terminated due to connection timeout, IAP-tunnel blip) before its iteration-6 send landed. The driver was patched (boss/pool transient 'error' listeners, --from resume flag, fail-closed empty verdict, idempotent run seed) and iteration 6 was re-run cleanly from a fresh revision. Iteration 6's recorded send/sentAt/observe window belongs to the resumed pass; the crashed pass contributed only the seed row.
driverIncident.records1to5: sentAt values reconstructed from pgboss.job.created_on of each run's first run.start row; observedMs is the driver's fixed 600000 ms watch window; logMarkers reconstructed from the worker log windows (all were 'building GKE launcher' cold-import entry lines).

records.pgboss: run.start fetched ~01:05 (provisioning set), hung past expire_seconds=900 in the cold import, retried to retry_limit=2, final state 'failed' (last fetch 01:30:19, failed 01:30:45). run.cancel completed 01:21:03.

run.start entered provisioning (cold-import marker at 01:22:28 on 00003-w6g), expired, retried twice, final state 'failed' (01:40:31/01:57:48). run.cancel itself failed after 2 retries — consumer starvation. Run ended state 'failed'.

revision 00004-k7j crashed at cold start: '[worker] failed to start: Error: timeout exceeded when trying to connect' → Container exit(1) at 01:31:17. run.start first fetched only at 01:51:22 by a later instance, exhausted retries → 'failed'; a retry row was still pending at 02:07. Job never consumed inside the watch window.
run.start sat 'created' through the whole watch window; only fetched 02:08:12 (state 'active', unconsumed at teardown read). run.cancel failed after 2 retries.

cold-import marker at 01:53:34 on 00006-wbz; run.start fetched 02:02:43 (16.7 min after send), still 'active' at teardown read — handler hung in the throttled import past the 600 s watch. run.cancel eventually completed 02:02:17.

run.start stayed 'created' for the entire 601.8 s watch (job row created_on 01:58:01.626Z; a pg-boss retry row appeared 02:07:35). Never consumed. NOTE: this is the resumed driver's record — the first pass crashed driver-side on rev 00007-hmp before its send (see driverIncident).

sloSamples.query: select signal,detail,value_ms,run_id,at from slo_samples where signal='run_start_stage_ms'
sloSamples.note: ZERO run_start_stage_ms samples of any detail (no 'admit', no 'mint', no 'job_launch') across all six iterations — the launch path never reached its first SLO write.
